LJCDataColumns.summary: Represents a collection of LJCDataColumn objects.
LJCDataColumns.remarks: A DataColumn collection element can be retrieved by name using the collection object: dataColumns["ColumnName"];

LJCCompareColumn.summary: Compare column value to key column value.

LJCDeserialize.summary: Deserializes from the specified XML file.

LJCObjectColumns.summary: Gets a collection of items from a data object.

LJCObjectColumnsInList.summary: Gets a collection of items from a data object that match the supplied property Names.

LJCObjectPropertyNames.summary: Gets a list of property names from a data object.

LJCSearchColumns.summary: Custom binary search for Name value.

ToDataValues.summary: Operator to create LJCDataValues from LJCDataColumns.

LJCKeys.summary: Gets or sets the key columns.

Item.summary: Gets the item with the supplied property name.

CopyConstructor.summary: Initializes an object from the supplied items.

Clone.summary: Creates and returns a clone of the object.

HasItems.summary: Checks if the collection has items.

LJCColumns.summary: Returns a collection of columns that match the supplied property names.

LJCKeyPropertyNames.summary: Gets a list of property names from the collection items.

LJCPropertyNames.summary: Gets a list of property names from the collection items.

Add1.summary: Adds the object element to the collection

Add2.summary: Creates the Object from the arguments and adds it to the collection.

Add3.summary: Creates the Object from the arguments and adds it to the collection.

LJCGetUnique.summary: Gets the column that matches the key columns.

LJCSort.summary: Sorts on the current key columns.

LJCChanged.summary: Gets a collection of changed columns.

LJCClearChanged.summary: Sets the IsChanged value to false for all elements in the collection.

LJCMapNames.summary: Maps the column property and rename values.
